gen-gf-bellota-gf-antic: Antic reads like one nib drawn straight through, with open letter mouths. Bellota's dangling s terminals and stylus-traced strokes give the heading a commanding look above that quieter, contemporary text.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-biz-udpgothic: BIZ UDPGothic spaces its letters lavishly, leaving a clear channel into rounds. Bellota does the wire-bent sign look best, constant in thickness, while BIZ UDPGothic handles generous, approachable spacing better.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-cairo: Display swagger over a wide-channeled body: Bellota draws every glyph in one thickness, while Cairo opens a generous channel into every bowl. Modern and professional, they stack up cleanly.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-cantarell: Cantarell reads approachably, its c tips pulled well apart and its r, n and m arches matching their stems. Bellota is happiest big and brief, where its commanding character shows.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-catamaran: Distinctive Bellota hums at a constant line weight, a flat gray texture that never swells. And Catamaran's curvy, unclamped letters below keep the whole pairing feeling neutral and approachable.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-commissioner: Commanding Bellota hangs its s terminals wide and traces every stroke with one stylus width, over Commissioner's smooth, unclogged text. Give the heading plenty of size and let the sans text stay modest.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-didact-gothic: Modern Didact Gothic never snags on a closed-up bowl, each stroke pulling equal visual weight beneath Bellota. Bellota's heading wants generous size, while the text beneath can stay modest.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-electrolize: Contemporary Electrolize has an open-jawed c like a pair of pliers, while Bellota gives headings a blueprint-lettering feel. Extended into pages, the text holds a crisp, modern rhythm line after line.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-elms-sans: Modern Elms Sans draws a ballpoint's pressure-free line, with a see-through gap in each s, under Bellota's commanding heading. Paragraph after paragraph, it reads light and unforced, never pressing on the eye.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-encode-sans: Encode Sans reads cleanly, its gaps keeping c from ever looking like an o. And Bellota, with no vertical emphasis or horizontal thinning, gives the heading a distinctive look.
